_note: The world anchor. Its frame is built from two tracked bodies rather than one, so the 1651 mm chord between them fixes the rail's direction instead of a 120 mm marker triangle. Everything this project publishes is stated in this frame.

placements._note: Pink body, at the URDF's -Y end. Its pivot was set by hand in Motive at the CAD point mount_a names -- which it has to be, because there is no mount offset in this system any more and Motive's rigid-body frame IS this placement's frame. Recreate the body and mount_a is void until the pivot is set again.

calibrated.motive_asset_rev: pink = streaming id 4, blue = streaming id 5
calibrated.note: Pivots set by hand at CAD points -- which is the whole mount calibration, since there is no offset field to correct them. Baseline is 1651 mm, not the full rail -- moving the bodies further apart is the cheapest accuracy in the system, and it multiplies into every object because this is the anchor.
